project_identity.name: Caret
project_identity.nature: Cline-based fork with minimal extension strategy
project_identity.philosophy: Preserve Cline core, extend through caret-src/

merge_strategy.phase_0_rule: .agents/context MUST be restored BEFORE any code merging begins
merge_strategy.hybrid_pattern: Preserve Cline core, inject Caret logic via interception
merge_strategy.logic_based_3way: Compare Base(Cline) vs Target(Caret) vs Merged logic, not just text diffs

modification_levels.L2_conditional: minimal Cline changes with backup + comment

branding_policy.rule: 브랜드명/규칙/파일명을 계산할 때는 반드시 위 유틸 함수를 호출하고 문자열을 하드코딩하지 않는다.

tdd_phases: Phase 1 RED: Write integration test first
Phase 2 GREEN: Minimal code to pass

notes: `npm run protos` → 실행 스크립트: caret-scripts/build/build-proto.mjs (TS/JS용 generated 코드 전체 관리)
`npm run protos-go` → 실행 스크립트: scripts/build-go-proto.mjs (CLI용 Go gRPC 클라이언트, src/generated/grpc-go/ 경로)
src/generated/** 와 src/shared/proto/** 는 스크립트로만 갱신하고 수동 편집 금지

mandatory_pre_checks: NO coding without document review first
Cline file modification: comment-only (no .cline backups); new files in protected dirs must have CARET MODIFICATION header

workflows.instruction: Read these files ON DEMAND when performing specific tasks. Do not read all at once.

steps: Extract keywords from the user request
Read the matching root quick reference first
Load the workflow document only if the task still needs details
Use Korean developer docs (caret-docs/development/**) when updating human-facing guidance
